title: Rain Dancer
summary: Quarterstaff casts Create Water once per Short Rest.

fields.Weapon profile: 1d6 Bludgeoning one-handed or 1d8 two-handed plus Strength. Simple, Versatile, Dippable, 5 ft melee.
fields.Create Water: Level 1, Action, 30 ft range and 13 ft radius. Extinguishes exposed flames, creates a Water surface, and makes creatures in the area Wet for 3 turns. Once per Short Rest.
fields.Wet: Fire resistance and normally Vulnerability to Cold and Lightning. Existing resistance to Cold or Lightning is cancelled instead. Wet breaks ordinary Invisibility and clears equipped coatings. It freezes a creature that is already Chilled. Wet grants immunity to Burning and Wild Magic: Burning.
fields.Topple: Action once per Short Rest with proficiency. Melee attack for 1d4 nonlethal Bludgeoning. Dexterity save against weapon-action DC +2 or Prone for 1 turn, expiring at the start of the target’s turn. Falling Prone breaks Concentration. Topple skips main-hand weapon effects.
fields.Acquisition: Arron near the Silvanus statue in the Emerald Grove.
fields.Base value: 100 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
